notes.title: Try There’s No Santa – Now Free to Play!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994142/11e8f1eae2bd5e797cfa70b43f1420e42b2699f7.png[/img]

If you enjoy relaxing, colorful, and creative experiences, we’ve got a new game for you this holiday season: [i][b]There’s No Santa[/b][/i]!

This festive hidden-object game is perfect for puzzle lovers and casual gamers looking for a cozy and fun experience. [b]Best of all, it’s FREE[/b]!

[b]🌟 Features include:[/b]
[list]
[*] 4 beautifully festive locations to explore 🎄
[*] Endless replayability with randomized objects 🎁
[*] 3 difficulty levels for all players 🔧
[*] Achievements, zoom, and hint system to make your hunt easier 🏆
[/list]
🎮 Play now and embrace the joy of finding hidden treasures while basking in holiday cheer!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3192350/Theres_No_Santa

[b]Bonus Recommendation! 🎨[/b]
If you enjoy creativity and vibrant gameplay, dive back into [i][b]Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number[/b][/i] - [b]it's also FREE, including the achievements[/b]. 🏆 Relax with [b]over 100+ pixel images[/b] and bring them to life with colors or textured cross-stitching! Perfect for unwinding after a festive object-hunt session.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3071670/Pixel_Cross_Stitch_Color_by_Number/
